verdict.rationale: IP India's own pages list sanctioned third-party channels: an Electronic Register of Patent Agents, a list of IP Mitras (Patent Facilitators) under the SIPP scheme, and Design Facilitators. Together these show an official rail through which registered representatives act for applicants. The evidence is limited to navigation titles, so the scope of authorization and the mechanics of appointing an agent are undocumented. missing for 10: documentation of how an agent or representative is authorized (power of attorney or authorization forms), the scope of actions agents can take on e-filing, verification of agent status, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the service documents a sanctioned third-party rail — designees, authorized providers, registered agents, or representatives — through which a provider can act for my company

citations.quote: List of IP Mitras (Patent Facilitators) under SIPP Scheme
